title: Aspiring Engineer
description: Apprentice software engineer at CY Tech and Atos.
about: I am currently an Application Developer apprentice at Atos. I have experience in web development and primarily work with Java. I am also pursuing part-time studies at CY Tech. I am interested in international internship opportunities and have been learning Japanese for almost three years.
about-p2: After completing a web development course at the Reims University (URCA) and get a BTEC Higher National Diploma equivalent, where I gained skills in PHP, Symfony, C#, .NET, and many other technologies, as well as a solid foundation in accounting, IT law, and project management, I am now pursuing part-time studies at CY Tech to become a software engineer. As an apprentice developer at Atos, I have the opportunity to apply my knowledge to real-world projects, further strengthening my technical and professional expertise.
about-p3: Curious by nature, I am always looking for new things to learn and new projects to work on!
about-p4: Here’s a short list of technologies I use:
hsd-title: High School Diploma, Lycée Marie-Curie, Versailles
hsd-desc: I obtained my High School Diploma with a focus on Digital and Computer Science (NSI) and Mathematics in 2021.
BTEC-desc: After graduating from high school, I pursued a web development course in Reims, where I specialized in .NET development.
engineer: Master’s Degree in Engineering as Apprentice at CY Tech - Atos
engineer-desc: To complete my academic path, I chose a software engineering program in CY Tech. The apprenticeship format allows me to acquire and apply my learning in real-world projects.
kanapp: Kanapp is an application for storing and viewing Kanji (Japanese characters).
memorize: A flashcard mobile app designed to enhance memorization, based on a spaced repetition algorithm.
aoc: Web extension of a board game for managing a champagne production estate.
wws: WordPress page scraping tools developed as part of an internship.
zelda: Video game development project using JavaFx.
contact-desc: A project? An offer? I’m always open to new opportunities, feel free to reach out—my inbox is always open!
